# GoldMoodAstro

> GoldMoodAstro is an online marketplace for astrology, tarot, numerology and personal-reflection consultations. It provides live audio/video sessions with approved consultants and self-service astrology tools in Turkish, English and German.

## Official entity

- Brand: GoldMoodAstro
- Operator: Orhan Güzel – Softwareentwicklung
- Canonical website: [goldmoodastro.com](https://goldmoodastro.com)
- Service area: Online; Turkish, English and German
- Currencies: TRY for Turkish checkout; EUR for English and German checkout
- Contact: [goldmoodastro@gmail.com](mailto:goldmoodastro@gmail.com)
- Editorial scope: Personal awareness, personal development, personal reflection and entertainment

## How the service works

1. A user compares consultant profiles, expertise, language, services, pricing and availability.
2. The user chooses an instant or scheduled service and completes checkout when payment is required.
3. Card payments use Stripe Checkout. PayPal may be offered inside Stripe Checkout for supported currencies; PayPal is not available for TRY.
4. The consultant and user meet through the platform's LiveKit-based audio/video flow or use the applicable asynchronous service.
5. Users can review completed services and use platform messaging where available.

## Responsible-use boundary

GoldMoodAstro content and consultations are for personal awareness, personal development, personal reflection and entertainment. They do not replace qualified professional or emergency services, and the platform does not promise deterministic or guaranteed outcomes. See the site's current legal and editorial policies for the complete service boundary.
